description: Dex helps you manage personal and professional relationships in ChatGPT. Find and update contacts, organize tags and groups, log notes, manage reminders and keep-in-touch cadence, and review upcoming birthdays and follow-ups. Search connected mailbox metadata, manage connected calendar events, and read or request cited public-web research on contacts.
